address.description: Address to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::1'). Empty string binds to all interfaces.

sameorigin.description: Restrict protocol upgrades if the Origin header does not match the requested HTTP Host.

origin.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origin host:port combinations. Empty string allows any origin.

ssl.description: Enable HTTPS listening. Requires sslcert and sslkey.

sslcert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file. Required if ssl is true.

sslkey.description: Path to the SSL private key file. Required if ssl is true.

passenv.description: List of environment variable names allowed to be passed to executed scripts.

reverselookup.description: Perform DNS reverse lookups on remote clients.

dir.description: Local directory containing scripts to be accessed as WebSockets. Mutually exclusive with command.

staticdir.description: Directory to serve static files over HTTP. Cannot be used with devconsole.

cgidir.description: Directory to serve CGI scripts over HTTP.

devconsole.description: Enable interactive development console. Cannot be used with staticdir or cgidir.

loglevel.description: Log level: debug, trace, access, info, error, fatal.

command.description: The executable command to run. Mutually exclusive with dir.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command.
